name: Mian Tiara
bio:
Mian Tiara (born December 28, 1977) is an Indonesian singer, writer, and actress.

In 2002, Mian Tiara was involved in the soundtrack album for the film Seventh House with the song title "Mimpi dan Rumah Ketujuh".

His first album, released in 2010, was entitled The Comfort of My Own Company , assisted by a number of musicians such as Riza Arshad, Indra Lesmana , Nikita Dompas, Indra Perkasa, Andra Perdana, Avi Bortnick, Elfa Zulham Syah, and John Navid.

credits.title: The Call
credits.overview: A chronically online young woman goes viral after sharing cryptic phone calls from her dead mother. As her story spreads across social media, the recording force her to confront a story she’d rather bury.

credits.title: Sara
credits.overview: Sara, a transgender woman goes back to her remote hometown to attend her father’s funeral. She finds the village has changed greatly, and that the villagers have become extremely religious. Added to that, her mother suffers from dementia and treats her like a complete stranger.

credits.title: Bisikan Desa Gringsing
credits.overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

credits.title: Nobody Loves Kay
credits.overview: Kay, a high school gamer, loses his best friend to become a pro. After a setback, he rises again and meets his rival in the Mobile Legends world finals.

credits.title: Lost in the Spotlight
credits.overview: Just as he lands a prestigious role, a famous actor mysteriously loses his ability to act, sparking a journey of self-discovery amid public pressure.

credits.title: This is Budi's Mother
credits.overview: The death of his mother plunges Budi into the feelings of loss and sadness that he has yet to understand. To process his feelings, Budi must go on a journey to find a final resting place for his mother.

credits.title: All We Need Is Time
credits.overview: One year after the accident of his elder sister, Ombak, a suicide survivor gets an anxiety attack because he is tortured by remorse and guilt-tripping from his mother.

credits.title: The Last 7 Days
credits.overview: A curse on their recently deceased mother leaves Tari and her brother Kadar with only seven days to free her soul and protect their family from darkness.

credits.title: Little Rebels Cinema Club
credits.overview: 2008, the Indonesian city of Parepare. Together with his best friends, 14-year-old Doddy tries to recreate an iconic scene from a zombie movie and record it with the video camera that belongs to his sad and angry emo brother, Anji.

credits.title: Blood Debt
credits.overview: The old factory where Erwina works holds a dark secret - and because her family owes a debt to the devil, she must pay a terrible price for being there.

credits.title: Intan Cahaya Bumi
credits.overview: After being left behind by her friend who was transferred out of town, Intan, an introverted Pawnshop Appraiser, feels increasingly lonely and bored with her routine, making her want to make a radical decision, but it is hindered by the people closest to her who love her dearly.

credits.title: Temurun
credits.overview: After their mother dies during a violent break-in, two siblings move in with their estranged father discover their family's sinister heritage.

credits.title: Grave Torture
credits.overview: When a violent act kills her parents, Sita vows to debunk the idea of supernatural torment after death — a fixation that leads her on a dark quest.

credits.title: The Corpse Washer
credits.overview: Lela, a mortician, finds something odd about the body of her mother who died suddenly. Trapped in sacred tension and a tense horror journey, Lela discovers another oddity in the body of the corpse she was bathing.

credits.title: The Devil’s Cult
credits.overview: A pair of twins come to a remote village to find out the cause of their father's strange death, but they end up trapped in a dangerous village full of terror.

credits.title: Sleep Call
credits.overview: Loneliness, past trauma and debts keep Dina trapped in a complicated life. Then she found the Sleep Call activity - a happiness and an escape from the real world, but it leads to terror and disaster.

credits.title: Kajiman: Iblis Terkejam Penagih Janji
credits.overview: Humans will do anything to get what they want. Despite making a pact with the strongest magical being, Kajiman.

credits.title: Sri Asih
credits.overview: Alana discover the truth about her origin: she’s not an ordinary human being. She may be the gift for humanity and become its protector as Sri Asih. Or a destruction, if she can’t control her anger.

credits.title: Satan's Slaves 2: Communion
credits.overview: After moving from their home to an apartment building, a new terror awaits Rini’s family.

credits.title: First, Second & Third Love
credits.overview: While caring for their respective parents, Asia and Raja meet in a hospital and fall in love, but a bittersweet secret changes everything.

credits.title: Yuni
credits.overview: In her last year of secondary school, a bright Indonesian student is determined to pursue her education and resist getting married, despite the expectations of her community.

credits.title: Photocopier
credits.overview: When photos of her at a party cause her to lose a scholarship, a student investigates whether something devastating happened to her that night.

credits.title: Impetigore
credits.overview: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she's unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

credits.title: What's Up with Cinta 2
credits.overview: 14 years after their budding romance in high school, Rangga and Cinta reunite in Yogyakarta to have their closure after Rangga had left Cinta with no explanation years prior.
